title: Devastator — The Capture of Tantive IV
description: The accepted capture scene rebuilt with a true wedge perimeter, shallow sloped armour, compact independent flight cradles, chamfered command decks and seven bevelled blue exhausts. Tantive IV remains suspended beneath the illuminated ventral hangar, with two TIE escorts.

sections.name: Shallow port and starboard armour planes
Continuous wedge edges and recessed trenches
Shield globes, bridge aerial and concentrated service equipment
